fact: On 22 January 2026 the civil registration agency ANEC and the statistics agency ANSD signed an interoperability protocol giving effect to article 40 of the Code de la famille, which requires regular transmission of civil-status facts to the national statistical service.
title: Sécurisation des données de l'état civil : l'ANEC et l'ANSD scellent un partenariat stratégique pour un système plus fiable
